snippet.title: Friday Night Funkin: Tricky Mod Clowned Out RELEASE
snippet.description:
Ya can download it right here:

https://gamebanana.com/mods/714051
--

After three months of hard work, we’re finally able to release this remake of the Tricky Mod! We rebuilt it from scratch and added a few small extras here and there.

I hope you enjoy it!

A huge thank you to everyone who worked on this with me. I had a fantastic time doing it.

Note about any possible future updates:
There will be a small patch in the future to replace the current transformation cutscene between Madness and Hellclown. The intended cutscene hasnt been animated yet.

The comic you’ll find in the extras menu is still considered “canon” within the mod’s storyline, even though it was never finished. Originally, I wanted to create a short comic for the intro and ending of Clown Week, but I decided against it because I wasn’t happy with how the first page turned out. There simply wasn’t enough time to keep refining it, and it would have taken far too long to meet the schedule.  I also won’t be able to continue working on this mod post-release.

The original plan for the ending was simple: Tricky would torch the “FNF Mode” text, allowing him to actually harm GF and BF. He had his fun, but wanted to get it over with. Hank would distract him by shooting at the back of Trickys head, followed by Sanford and Deimos showing up with their truck to rescue BF and GF and get them out of there.

In hindsight, I would have loved to add even more to this mod, like giving every menu character a proper idle-break animation, adding a few more animations for Tricky during his songs, or even introducing one or two entirely new phases referencing Trickys involvement in the Madness Combat series. Unfortunately, I just didn’t have the time, as I also have a full-time job. I also didnt want to be stuck on this project for too long.

Regardless we all hope that you enjoy playing!
---
None of us will make any money from this as it was made for the fun of it. But if youd like to support it, ya can always donate on my Patreon or Kofi.

http://patreon.com/banbuds
https://ko-fi.com/banbuds
